name: Kate
source:
A young, happy girl moves from the provinces to the big city, born and raised in a culturally strict family, succumbs to the temptations of the big city, meets new people and prospects. She is not alone, she has a boyfriend, Archie, with whom they have been together for several years and are very much in love. What would happen if you gave this woman her freedom? Will she take advantage of the opportunity or will it improve her relationship?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/wetmelonplay/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一名在传统严苛家庭中长大的快乐年轻女孩，从外省小地方搬到了繁华大都市；面对花花世界的重重诱惑，她结识了形形色色的新面孔，也迎来了崭新的人生机遇。她并非孤身一人——她有一位相恋数年、彼此深爱的男友阿奇。假如给予这位女性彻底的自由，究竟会发生什么？她会借机放纵自我，还是会让两人的感情愈发稳固？

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/wetmelonplay/about]Patreon[/url]]
